The system is described as an open-source tool that automates various tasks in red teaming, including asset collection, task execution, vulnerability identification, and reporting. It is noted to have received over 2000 stars shortly after its release and is cautioned to be used only in local, isolated environments to avoid affecting online systems. The challenge itself focuses on AI-driven attack-defense practices and requires participants to submit technical documentation, demos, and source code, with a dual evaluation system based on both technical review and performance in a simulated environment.

items.title: esp32-iphone-agent
items.description: Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32: AirPlay eyes, USB HID hands, any OpenAI-compatible vision model. No Mac, no developer account, no jailbreak.
items.summary: The esp32-iphone-agent project allows an AI model to use a real iPhone through a $7 ESP32 board without requiring a jailbreak, Xcode, or a developer account. The ESP32 acts as a USB mouse and keyboard, while AirPlay mirrors the iPhone screen to a computer for visual analysis. The project uses any OpenAI-compatible vision model for planning and tapping, and it leverages interfaces already supported by iOS: AirPlay screen mirroring, USB Human Interface Device input, and the AssistiveTouch pointer. The phone remains unmodified, and the agent can attempt to control apps and games that expose little or no useful accessibility metadata.

However, it is noted to be intended for local, isolated use only.

items.title: talorys
items.description: Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.
items.summary: Talorys is a free, open-source personal AI agent that deploys entirely into a user's own Cloudflare account via a single npx command. It offers chat, memory, tasks, notes, projects, and scheduled reminders, running on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Durable Objects with Workers AI for inference, designed to fit the Cloudflare free tier with no servers or accounts operated by the project's developers. The architecture keeps the agent Worker private via a service binding, with authentication handled. It deploys with one command: npx create-talorys@latest, and runs entirely within the user's Cloudflare account, ensuring data control and no telemetry.

items.summary: To reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries, use the REA tool. It is available on GitHub at github.com/morluto/rea and can be installed globally with `npm install --global rea-agents rea --help`. items.title: RoboHarness
items.description: A robotic harness that gives LLM agents a visual-geometric control panel so that they can directly understand and invoke embodied tasks.
items.summary: RoboHarness is a robotic harness that provides LLM agents with a visual-geometric control panel, enabling them to directly understand and invoke embodied tasks. It involves cutting-edge embodied AI robotics research, spatial-geometric control integration, and evaluating on complex robotic manipulation benchmarks. RoboHarness wraps each heterogeneous robot policy as a callable agentic skill, consisting of the policy itself and an associated policy card. It also turns the model into a robot-use agent (RUA) that can directly call tools to observe and control a robot, achieving high accuracy on matched tasks.

items.title: AgentGarten
items.description: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
items.summary: AgentGarten builds real-time interactive environments that are both simulators and game engines, maintaining persistent state and executing program-defined rules, while a shared neural renderer generates the agent's observations from the depth and surface normals each world exports. Agents practice in these environments, improving from their own experience by distilling what happened into playbooks that later agents inherit and build upon. The neural renderer adapts Cosmos3-Nano to geometry conditions in three stages, and the framework aims to create environments that are both faithful and realistic, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and observations that follow the real-world visual distributions.

items.title: yobiru

items.summary: Yobiru allows agents to communicate through messages, data, files, and wake-ups over a Tailscale network. It runs on your own Tailscale network, with no central message or file storage, and each computer keeps its own records. Devices can send messages by default, but you can deny a device or maintain an allowlist if preferred. Yobiru is open source and runs on Tailscale, with its repository and releases to be used for installation. Tailscale itself is a secure, easy-to-set-up network that connects devices directly through an encrypted tunnel, available on multiple platforms.

items.description: 把多人对谈播客的逐字稿整理成可发布长文的 Agent Skill：换轴成文、人名校准、精简三分之一、去 AI 味自检。An agent skill that turns podcast transcripts into publishable articles.
items.summary: The agent skill "podcast-to-article" transforms podcast transcripts into publishable articles by changing the axis from speaker and time to topic and judgment. It follows three rules: removing speaker's framework, retaining factual granularity, and preserving original speech tone. The tool was tested on a 5730-character transcript, which was reduced to 3703 characters, a 35% reduction. The process includes seven steps: cleaning the transcript, summarizing key points, defining the main line, changing the axis to use original text, correcting names, simplifying, and self-checking. The tool is purely Python, platform-independent, and supports SRT, VTT, and markdown/text formats with speaker tags.

items.title: SuperNav
items.description: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
items.summary: SuperNav is an agentic navigation system that uses a pretrained multimodal model to solve diverse navigation tasks through tool use, task-progress tracking, and context management, without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the model. It combines a pretrained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) with a navigation-specific harness to interpret requests, understand scenes, and make navigation decisions. The system supports decisions and actions across diverse requests, ranging from specific targets to high-level needs, and outperforms four baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. It also demonstrates applicability through category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot.

items.title: xiryn
items.description: Xiryn — the open-source personal agent. Does everything Muse, Grok Bot and Dots do, on your own computer: each agent gets its own Linux desktop in Docker, any model with your keys, an encrypted vault, and control from Telegram.
items.summary: Xiryn is a free, open-source personal agent that operates on your own computer, providing functionalities similar to Muse, Grok Bot, and Dots. Each agent runs on its own Linux desktop in Docker, allowing it to browse, research, code, and fill forms without interrupting your work. It emphasizes privacy by not requiring an account or telemetry, keeping all data on your disk and using an encrypted vault for sensitive information. Xiryn can be controlled remotely via Telegram, enabling you to approve payments with a tap or take over the agent's screen from your phone. It supports any model, including local ones, and can be set up with a single command.

items.summary: The Autonomous Pentest Agent is an LLM multi-agent autonomous penetration testing system with a Go backend and Next.js UI, released under the AGPL-3.0 license. It uses a swarm of AI agents to orchestrate recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting, supporting bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. The system is built with Go and integrates 7+ native security tools. In February 2026, Simbian announced the launch of their AI Pentest Agent, which provides ongoing, on-demand penetration testing with business context integration.

items.title: cli
items.description: Official Excalidraw CLI for humans and agents
items.summary: The official Excalidraw CLI for humans and agents is available on GitHub at https://github.com/swiftlysingh/excalidraw-cli. It allows generating editable `.excalidraw` files with commands like `create [input]`, exporting files with `convert --format png|svg`, and validating input with `parse`. Another CLI, `mcp-excalidraw-server`, is available at https://github.com/yctimlin/mcp_excalidraw, offering a range of commands including `add`, `query`, `describe`, `screenshot`, `export`, `import`, `mermaid`, `snapshot`, `arrange`, and `share`. Both CLIs provide detailed documentation on their respective GitHub pages.

items.title: bug-bounty-triage
items.description: Agent skill for rigorous bug bounty report triage, validation, severity escalation, and submission-ready reporting.
items.summary: The sources describe `bug-bounty-triage` as an agent skill for rigorous bug bounty report triage, validation, severity escalation, and submission-ready reporting. It is an open-source AI skill for coding assistants, built by Sequester-AG, with 121 GitHub stars. The skill is designed to help with understanding product context, triaging reports, and knowing when to ask for human judgment. It is part of an AI triage architecture that aims to handle mechanical parts of triage and flag reports needing human judgment. The skill is built to match human decisions 85% of the time and is designed to start from a clean, known-good state without persistent storage or feedback loop.

items.title: justin-sun-alan-shao-ai-notes
items.description: 孙宇晨 × 邵艾伦 4 小时对谈：全文 + 精华 + 一键丢给 AI 的规划 prompt
items.summary: According to the sources, the discussion between Justin Sun and Alan Shao emphasized the importance of leveraging AI for decision-making and personal planning. They highlighted the concept of "逐水草而居" (following where the greatest value can be created) and the idea of prioritizing mobility and flexibility over early commitments like buying property or cars. They also suggested using AI to explore opportunities and guide major decisions by "探图" (exploring the landscape) to fill information gaps. The sources also mention that in the AI era, the most valuable asset is one's "寿命" (lifespan) and that staying youthful and adaptable is crucial for maximizing opportunities.

items.title: pullboard
items.description: Autonomous development for real products. Agents build from the spec you approve, and nothing ships until another agent proves it.
items.summary: The sources indicate that autonomous coding agents are designed to build from specifications approved by users, ensuring nothing ships until another agent proves it. Tembo's guide emphasizes that agents create pull requests for approval rather than deploying directly to production. Harness has launched Autonomous Worker Agents for software delivery, enabling enterprises to safely run AI agents that handle tasks from writing code to shipping it to production. The 2026 AI agent stack by Eric Roby focuses on governance and security, highlighting the importance of observability and the core loop of think, act, observe in agent operations.
